messages.content: How long would it take to travel from Boston to New York by car?

function.name: calculate_distance
function.description: Calculate the distance between two geographical coordinates in miles. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

destination.description: The destination coordinate with latitude and longitude as decimal values.

message.content:
The straight‑line (great‑circle) distance between Boston (42.3601 N, 71.0589 W) and New York City (40.7128 N, 74.0060 W) is roughly **215 miles**.  
If you drive at an average speed of about **65 mph** (typical interstate speed limit), the trip would take:

\[
\text{time} = \frac{\text{distance}}{\text{speed}} \approx \frac{215}{65} \approx 3.3 \text{ hours}
\]

So you’re looking at **about 3 hours 20 minutes** under normal conditions. In practice, traffic, stops, and weather can add 30–60 minutes or more.
